- Build a complete, playable 3D action-adventure story game with an open-world feel and AAA-quality presentation, making reasonable assumptions without clarification.

- Deliver a playable game now.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Created **EMBERFALL — The Last Light**, a browser-based Three.js adventure set on the Sundered Coast.

- Used procedural terrain, foliage, ruins, characters, enemies, lighting, and UI rather than external game assets.
